stem.en: Scientists find a new organism. It is multicellular and eukaryotic, it has no chlorophyll, and it absorbs food from a host. Fungi and Animalia both seem possible. Which check would best decide between them?

text.en: Count how many cells its body has.

feedback.en: Fungi and animals are both mostly multicellular, so this cannot decide.

text.en: Look for a cell wall made of chitin.

feedback.en: Right. Fungi have a chitin wall, and animal cells have no wall.

text.en: Test its cells for chlorophyll again.

feedback.en: Fungi and animals both lack chlorophyll, so this cannot decide.

text.en: Find out which host it feeds on.

feedback.en: Some fungi and some animals are parasites, so the host cannot decide.

explanation.en: Absorbing food points to Fungi, but it is not proof, because some parasitic animals absorb food too. A chitin wall decides it: fungi have one, and animal cells have no wall.

hints.en: Which feature do fungi have that animals lack?
